context.description: A subtree run names the scenarios it leaves out

evidence.trustReason: Fresh-context review of verify-spec-VF8.spec.ts (4 tests, 30 expects; my own run at 2e6ff969e3: 4 pass, 0 fail, exit 0). Given the release-notes spec: a committed copy in a git instance. For each case the test computes the left-out ids from the loaded scenarios' needs (a need that is neither in the run nor an outside precondition) and pins them by hand from acceptance/*.md. I checked the pins against the needs lines: T1.1 keeps S2 and S7; T1.2 keeps S3; T8 and T9 are outside. The test also asserts that some scenarios are kept and some left out. When: the real TaskCommand.run on the T1.1 and T1.2 task folders (neither folder has an after key), with the real harness and loader; the job starts (one start, not refused). Then the first message names each left-out scenario: the noReply message has one part whose lines are exactly the subtree header and 'Left out: <ids> — they need tasks outside this run.'; the named ids equal the pinned set, and no kept id is named. And the header metadata lists the same ids: part metadata equals {taskHarness:{header:{spec,task,leftOut}}} with leftOut equal to the same array in the message order. Controls: the whole spec and the T1 folder give no Left out line and leftOut []. VF8 does not depend on the run supervisor trust-drop defect (no trust and no live supervisor).
